2501f5e9ffa3bcd00e961c4ce9b7b40dea533be3.applies_when: Object not held, pose estimate fresh (at most 200 ms) and inside the tabletop frame.
2501f5e9ffa3bcd00e961c4ce9b7b40dea533be3.instructions: Observe, then pick the object with the giver at the observed pose estimate with the given grasp height. Abort on an unreachable pose.

632d34ba639067e4af9d84c590c9e45d813603a1.applies_when: Body can move; the object or target pose is fresh (at most 200 ms) and not yet within reach.
632d34ba639067e4af9d84c590c9e45d813603a1.instructions: Observe, then move the robot until the object (to: object) or the target (to: target) is within reach. Abort on a point that is on no table.

7b6c68d21f3d909afe8078e69a49cb5fcd8c0679.applies_when: Box not held, pose estimate fresh (at most 200 ms) and inside the tabletop frame.
7b6c68d21f3d909afe8078e69a49cb5fcd8c0679.instructions: Observe, then pick the box at the observed pose estimate with the given grasp height. Abort on an unreachable pose.

d2feba93604bf20c1f8867b4448293e604e4608f.applies_when: Object held by the taker, target pose fresh (at most 200 ms) and inside the tabletop frame.
d2feba93604bf20c1f8867b4448293e604e4608f.instructions: Observe, then place the object the taker holds at the observed target pose and release it.

e0a1065711e98076c031dee4fe49d9a9572b6ea9.applies_when: Object held by the giver, observation fresh (at most 200 ms).
e0a1065711e98076c031dee4fe49d9a9572b6ea9.instructions: Observe, then pass the object the giver holds to the taker: the taker grasps it, the giver releases it.

e36f179c16a75e630db9f42f5b9d1c88b4b626a1.applies_when: Object not held and within reach, pose estimate fresh (at most 200 ms) and on a table.
e36f179c16a75e630db9f42f5b9d1c88b4b626a1.instructions: Observe, then pick the object at the observed pose estimate with the given grasp height. Only when the object is within reach; abort on an unreachable pose.

e3cd79f87b586217a86fc41639fc3d77ed2bbf94.applies_when: Box held, target pose fresh (at most 200 ms) and inside the tabletop frame.
e3cd79f87b586217a86fc41639fc3d77ed2bbf94.instructions: Observe, then place the held box at the observed target pose and release it.

ecac6ffe677111a3e698020f91cec420e0e5926c.applies_when: Object held, target within reach, target pose fresh (at most 200 ms) and on a table.
ecac6ffe677111a3e698020f91cec420e0e5926c.instructions: Observe, then place the held object at the observed target pose and release it. Only when the target is within reach.

fb0db4298a7783bca97030585bc2aaaa0dae44e9.applies_when: Full pick-place-v1 case: box on the table, target declared, both poses fresh.
fb0db4298a7783bca97030585bc2aaaa0dae44e9.instructions: Run pick-box, then place-box. Return control to the coordinator after release or on any unlisted failure.

fetch-v1.eligibility_rule:
- The harness lists a skill under "eligible_skills" only after checking its applies_when
  conditions (fresh poses, tabletop frame, whether the box is held and what is within reach) against the latest
  observations; do not re-check them. Skills read the box pose themselves, so it is not shown.
fetch-v1.goal: Move the box to target_pose (x, y, yaw) on the other table and release it. Pick and place only what within_reach says is reachable; go to it first otherwise.
fetch-v1.intro: You are the planner of a mobile robot harness for a fetch task: the object is on one table and its target on another, and the robot moves between them.

handover-v1.eligibility_rule:
- The harness lists a skill under "eligible_skills" only after checking its applies_when
  conditions (fresh poses, tabletop frame, whether who holds it) against the latest
  observations; do not re-check them. Skills read the box pose themselves, so it is not shown.
handover-v1.goal: Move the object to target_pose (x, y, yaw) on the tabletop and release it; the giver cannot reach the target, so it must be handed over first.
handover-v1.intro: You are the planner of a two-arm robot harness for a tabletop handover task: one arm (the giver) picks the object, hands it to the other (the taker), which places it.

pick-place-v1.eligibility_rule:
- The harness lists a skill under "eligible_skills" only after checking its applies_when
  conditions (fresh poses, tabletop frame, whether the box is held) against the latest
  observations; do not re-check them. Skills read the box pose themselves, so it is not shown.
pick-place-v1.goal: Move the box to target_pose (x, y, yaw) on the tabletop and release it.
pick-place-v1.intro: You are the planner of a robot-arm harness for a tabletop pick-and-place task.
